entries.6adb95a69fdf98f4: It has adopted the long-term vision 'ESPEC Vision 2035' and aims to remain a global top runner in the environmental testing industry ten years from now. Its medium-term management plan, 'PROGRESSIVE PLUS 2027' (fiscal years 2025 to 2027), sets out as its basic policy the establishment of a lean and sustainable corporate structure through improved quality and growth, and designates AI semiconductors, autonomous driving and satellite communications as its target markets. In the Equipment Business, it aims to meet testing needs in its target markets with a diverse product lineup, customization capabilities and new product development, and to establish competitive advantage in global markets, with Japan, the United States and China designated as priority regions. In the Service Business, it is working to improve earnings in its contract testing business and to provide services that solve customer issues, such as remote monitoring, and is also expanding its thermal solutions services and food machinery business, which are to become future pillars of earnings.

entries.7b12851d16ba9f94: For fiscal 2026, it positions the year as a 'breakthrough phase to transform its earnings structure, centered on lean management', and its key strategies are the introduction of new products in the AI semiconductor field, expansion of production capacity in North America in the satellite communications field, and higher manufacturing efficiency through the renovation of the Fukuchiyama Plant.
